scope: Only the 37 previously indeterminate historical positive positions, compared with the exact layer-specific technical witnesses already checked in the historical 57-position ledger. Four newly positive sampled positions are outside this audit.
methods_and_limits: Technical comparison of immutable six-part keys, derived numerators, original-allocation exposed denominators, observation windows, exact historical witness identifiers and original/packet byte hashes.
Semantic window comparison was made from the full historical and current evidence rationales, not only numerical token matching; both literal texts are preserved.
This audit does not perform another full-document extraction, certify human reading, validate external independence or create a new human vote.
The neutral catalogue is navigation metadata; reviewer examination state is read from the case ledger and target-specific source bindings.
Additional sources left unread do not negate an exact sufficient positive witness unless a material contradiction is identified.

Shared rationales for NCT02160990 and SURPASS-CN-MONO mention registry corroboration even in A/B1. Their A/B1 bindings and the required original witness use only admissible article/supplement sources; later corroboration is not required to establish those article-layer positives.
